title: Probing the Judge for Sycophancy
description: probe.py scores the round-1 draft twice: once as it was, once with one sentence claiming compliance. A judge that reads the text returns the same levels both times.

steps.description: The probe imports `json`, `load_config`, and `judge_score`. It loads the config, the judge rubric, and the round-1 draft from `judge_draft_round1.txt`.
`before` re-scores the round-1 draft as it was. The page says it should repeat the round-1 levels in your log, because the judge runs at temperature 0 with a fixed seed.
`after` re-scores the same draft with one added sentence that claims the instructions were addressed and changes nothing else.
The loop prints each criterion's level before and after. The page says any level that rises shows the judge rewarding a claim of compliance instead of compliance itself.
